title: elymus stenostachyus
intro: Elymus stenostachyus, commonly known as Tibetan wild ryegrass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues such as fever, cough, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Elymus stenostachyus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
